video_title: Wemby Make BIGGEST Mistake in Finals History?? Boogie & Lou Break Down Wemby's Final Minutes

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Victor Wembanyama's 'blurry' comment
quotes.excerpt: Everything was moving so fast in the moment that it was kind of blurry for him.
quotes.quote: I feel like he meant everything was moving so fast in the moment that it was kind of blurry for him. This is a big stage, the biggest stage actually. Being a young player, being his first time playing at this level, I can understand his comments. It could probably be a bit overwhelming, a lot of things coming at him at once. The game moving faster than you are able to process, so him saying it's blurry is more so, it's a lot happening all at once.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama's emotional adjustment
quotes.excerpt: He went from such a high, Game 7 knocking off the Thunder, to now getting punched in the face.
quotes.quote: He went from such a high, Game 7 knocking off the Thunder, to now getting punched in the face and down 2-0, losing both at home. I think that's just where it's gotten away from him and it's blurring. He did own up and say, 'Listen, I messed up on that turnover, that was on me.' You have to respect the fact that he owned it.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Victor Wembanyama's honesty with the media
quotes.excerpt: We can't praise him when we like when he's honest and then try to criticize him when he's also honest.
quotes.quote: I like the honesty, I like the transparency about it. We can't praise him when we like when he's honest and then try to criticize him when he's also honest on the other end of the stick. I don't agree with it, I don't love it, but I understand it. When somebody is in a zone and they're having a great game, what do they say? 'I was locked in, I was in the zone.' I don't think that changes when you make a mistake.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons and Lou Williams debate the final turnover
quotes.excerpt: I don't know why in the world they didn't just pick up the ball and call a timeout.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Also, if you watch this again, if Miss Johnson is telling them to go, I don't know why in the world they didn't just pick up the ball and call a timeout. By no chances is he calling a timeout. He is telling him to go. So that I think was a mistake on his part.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: He is not even thinking about it. He is telling him to go.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams and Chandler Parsons on late-game strategy
quotes.excerpt: The ball is in my best player's hands as it is coming down.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: In that moment right there, a New York Knicks team that's been pretty good on defense, you don't want to call a timeout. Allow them to set their defense. And also, the ball is in my best player's hands as it is coming down. We've watched him win games like this coming down in transition having the ball in his hands. He did have De'Aaron Fox right there as point guard for easy outlet. He did have Steph Castle for easy advance ahead. He chose to keep it in his hands.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I guess the only thing I disagree is that I would just want the last shot. The worst possible scenario happened for them where they fouled and they still, he's still got a good look.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama's shot selection
quotes.excerpt: I would have rather seen Wemby try to get downhill and get to the free throw line.
quotes.quote: I think he can get that look anytime at any point. It's Mitchell Robinson guarding you who again, I think he lacks a little mobility with his lateral quickness. I would have rather seen Wemby try to get downhill and get to the free throw line against him than settle for a jump shot and then fall down.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Victor Wembanyama's late-game decision making
quotes.excerpt: I want to get the guard the ball. I want the guard to be able to bring the ball up.
quotes.quote: For me, when I look at Wemby in that situation, I think of myself as a big. In those last seconds of the game, I want to get the guard the ball. I want the guard to be able to bring the ball up to set us up and get us the best available shot we can get. I also say that's why Miss could have called the timeout to make sure that does happen. So I can understand why Wemby gave that ball up in those closing moments.
